name: @intellectual-frontiers/anyfs-git
description: The Git stores of AnyFS: a branch of a repository kept as a store without touching the working tree, the index or the branch a person has checked out, and a working tree kept as a store that can commit what it holds. A batch is one commit, a revision is the digest of the bytes, and the branch is pushed and never forced.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
